---
title: "Bulk RNA-seq Transcriptomic Analysis of Granulosa Cells in PCOS"
subtitle: "Differential Expression (DESeq2), Pathway Enrichment (GO/KEGG), GSEA, and PPI Network Preparation (GSE138518)"
author: "Mohammad Reza Yavari Parand"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: show
    df_print: paged
params:
  input_file:
    label: "Select Input Counts Excel File (.xlsx):"
    value: "data/GSE138518_RNA.xlsx"
    input: file
  output_dir:
    label: "Select Output Directory:"
    value: "outputs"
    input: text
---

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)

# Define dynamic paths based on user parameters
input_path  <- params$input_file
out_base    <- params$output_dir
results_dir <- file.path(out_base, "results")
figures_dir <- file.path(out_base, "figures")

# Create output subdirectories automatically if they do not exist
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Verify input file existence
if (!file.exists(input_path)) {
  stop(paste("Input file not found at:", input_path, 
             "\nPlease place your file in the 'data/' folder or select it via 'Knit with Parameters'."))
}

message("Input file loaded from: ", normalizePath(input_path))
message("Outputs will be saved to: ", normalizePath(out_base))

# Read raw expression matrix
counts_data <- read_excel(input_path)
gene_info   <- counts_data[, 1:3]
raw_counts  <- counts_data[, 4:9]

# Ensure integer counts and assign Gene Symbols as rownames
raw_counts_int <- round(as.matrix(raw_counts))
rownames(raw_counts_int) <- counts_data$SYMBOL

# Construct sample metadata (N = Control, P = PCOS)
sample_names <- colnames(raw_counts_int)
group_labels <- ifelse(grepl("^N", sample_names), "Control", "PCOS")

colData <- data.frame(
  row.names = sample_names,
  condition = as.factor(group_labels)
)

# Filter out unexpressed/low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(raw_counts_int) > 1
counts_filtered <- raw_counts_int[keep, ]

# Run DESeq2 pipeline
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_filtered,
  colData   = colData,
  design    = ~ condition
)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract results (PCOS vs Control)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "PCOS", "Control"))
resOrdered <- res[order(res$padj), ]

# Export full DEG table
write.csv(as.data.frame(resOrdered), 
          file = file.path(results_dir, "DEG_PCOS_vs_Control.csv"))

# Display top differentially expressed genes
head(as.data.frame(resOrdered), 10)

res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
res_df$expression <- "Not Significant"
res_df$expression[res_df$padj < 0.1 & res_df$log2FoldChange > 1]  <- "Upregulated"
res_df$expression[res_df$padj < 0.1 & res_df$log2FoldChange < -1] <- "Downregulated"
res_df$expression <- as.factor(res_df$expression)

# Label top 15 most significant genes with extreme fold changes
res_df$delabel <- NA
top_genes <- res_df[res_df$padj < 0.001 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 3, ]
top_genes <- head(top_genes[order(top_genes$padj), ], 15)
res_df$delabel[res_df$gene %in% top_genes$gene] <- res_df$gene[res_df$gene %in% top_genes$gene]

p_volcano <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pvalue), color = expression, label = delabel)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "#E41A1C", 
                                "Downregulated" = "#377EB8", 
                                "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, color = "black", max.overlaps = 20, box.padding = 0.3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: PCOS vs Control", 
       x = "Log2 Fold Change", 
       y = "-Log10 p-value", 
       color = "Expression") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), legend.position = "right") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5)

print(p_volcano)

ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_dir, "Volcano_Plot_PCOS_Clean_Labeled.jpg"), 
       plot = p_volcano, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, device = "jpeg")


vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
top50_genes <- head(order(res$padj), 50)
mat <- assay(vsd)[top50_genes, ]
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat)))

annotation_col <- data.frame(Condition = colData$condition, row.names = rownames(colData))
ann_colors <- list(Condition = c(Control = "#377EB8", PCOS = "#E41A1C"))
heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#377EB8", "white", "#E41A1C"))(100)

# Render in HTML report
pheatmap(mat_scaled,
         color = heatmap_colors,
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
         border_color = NA, fontsize_row = 7.5, fontsize_col = 10,
         main = "Top 50 Differentially Expressed Genes (PCOS vs Control)")

# Save high-resolution image
pheatmap(mat_scaled,
         color = heatmap_colors,
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
         border_color = NA, fontsize_row = 7.5, fontsize_col = 10,
         main = "Top 50 Differentially Expressed Genes (PCOS vs Control)",
         filename = file.path(figures_dir, "Heatmap_Top50_PCOS.jpg"),
         width = 7, height = 9)


deg_genes <- res_df$gene[which(res_df$padj < 0.1 & !is.na(res_df$padj))]

gene_ids <- bitr(deg_genes, 
                 fromType = "SYMBOL", 
                 toType   = "ENTREZID", 
                 OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)

# GO Biological Processes
ego <- enrichGO(gene          = gene_ids$ENTREZID,
                OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType       = "ENTREZID",
                ont           = "BP",
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
                readable      = TRUE)

write.csv(as.data.frame(ego), file = file.path(results_dir, "GO_BP_Enrichment_Results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Dotplot of Top 15 GO Terms
if (nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) {
  p_go_dot <- dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15, title = "GO Biological Processes (PCOS vs Control)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"))
  
  print(p_go_dot)
  ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_dir, "GO_BP_Dotplot.jpg"), plot = p_go_dot, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, device = "jpeg")
}

# KEGG Pathway Enrichment
kegg_res <- enrichKEGG(gene = gene_ids$ENTREZID, organism = 'hsa', pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
kegg_res <- setReadable(kegg_res, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
write.csv(as.data.frame(kegg_res), file = file.path(results_dir, "KEGG_Pathway_Enrichment_Results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

if (nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_res)) > 0) {
  p_kegg_bar <- barplot(kegg_res, showCategory = 15, title = "KEGG Pathway Enrichment") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"))
  
  print(p_kegg_bar)
  ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_dir, "KEGG_Pathway_Barplot.jpg"), plot = p_kegg_bar, width = 8.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, device = "jpeg")
}


if (nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) {
  gene_list_fc <- res_df$log2FoldChange
  names(gene_list_fc) <- res_df$gene
  gene_list_fc <- na.omit(gene_list_fc)
  
  p_cnet <- cnetplot(ego, showCategory = 5, foldChange = gene_list_fc, circular = FALSE, colorEdge = TRUE) +
    scale_color_gradient2(name = "Log2 Fold Change", low = "#377EB8", mid = "white", high = "#E41A1C") +
    labs(title = "Gene-Concept Network of Top 5 GO Terms") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14))
  
  print(p_cnet)
  ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_dir, "GO_Gene_Concept_Network.jpg"), plot = p_cnet, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, device = "jpeg")
}

res_gsea_df <- na.omit(res_df)
entrez_ids_gsea <- bitr(res_gsea_df$gene, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
merged_gsea <- merge(res_gsea_df, entrez_ids_gsea, by.x = "gene", by.y = "SYMBOL")

geneList <- merged_gsea$log2FoldChange
names(geneList) <- merged_gsea$ENTREZID
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

gsea_go <- gseGO(geneList     = geneList,
                 OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
                 ont          = "BP",
                 minGSSize    = 15,
                 maxGSSize    = 500,
                 pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                 verbose      = FALSE)

# اصلاحیه شرطی ایمن برای جلوگیری از خطای setReadable در صورت خالی بودن خروجی GSEA
if (!is.null(gsea_go) && nrow(as.data.frame(gsea_go)) > 0) {
  gsea_go <- setReadable(gsea_go, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  write.csv(as.data.frame(gsea_go), file = file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_GO_Results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  p_ridge <- ridgeplot(gsea_go, showCategory = 15) + 
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = "GSEA Ridgeplot: Biological Processes") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  
  print(p_ridge)
  ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_dir, "GSE_GO_Ridgeplot.jpg"), plot = p_ridge, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, device = "jpeg")
} else {
  message("No significant GSEA terms found at the current p-value cutoff.")
}

sig_deg_df <- res_df %>% filter(padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)

ppi_input_data <- data.frame(
  gene   = rownames(sig_deg_df),
  log2FC = sig_deg_df$log2FoldChange,
  padj   = sig_deg_df$padj
)

write.csv(ppi_input_data, file = file.path(results_dir, "Hub_Genes_PPI_Input.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(head(ppi_input_data, 10), caption = "Top 10 Significant DEGs Exported for PPI Network Analysis")

sessionInfo()
